# pangolin_resource_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a single shared Pangolin resource policy (Enterprise) by ID; the inline default policy of a resource is refused. Secrets are never returned: `has_password`, `has_pincode` and `has_header_auth` only tell whether one is set. To browse the shared policies of the org, use `pangolin_resource_policies`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Single resource policy lookup by ID.
data "pangolin_resource_policy" "internal" {
  id = 7
}

output "policy_is_password_protected" {
  value = data.pangolin_resource_policy.internal.has_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The resource policy ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `apply_rules` (Boolean) Whether the access rules are evaluated.
- `email_whitelist_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the email whitelist is enabled.
- `has_header_auth` (Boolean) Whether header authentication is set.
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether a password is set.
- `has_pincode` (Boolean) Whether a PIN code is set.
- `header_auth_extended_compatibility` (Boolean) Extended compatibility flag of the header authentication, or `null` when none is set.
- `name` (String) Display name of the policy.
- `nice_id` (String) Readable ID, unique per org.
- `role_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the roles granted access (the org admin role is not listed).
- `rules` (Attributes List) Access rules of the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `skip_to_idp_id` (Number) IdP the login page jumps straight to, or `null`.
- `sso` (Boolean) Whether Pangolin SSO authentication is required.
- `user_ids` (List of String) IDs of the users granted access.
- `whitelist_emails` (List of String) Emails allowed through the whitelist.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The rule action (`ACCEPT`, `DROP`, `PASS`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `match` (String) The match type.
- `priority` (Number) The rule priority (lower number = higher priority).
- `rule_id` (Number) The rule ID.
- `value` (String) The value matched against.
